# PhoenixGenApi v2.22.0 - Table of Contents

> A library for fast develop APIs in Elixir cluster, using Phoenix Channels for transport data, auto pull api configs from service nodes.

## Pages

- [Architecture](https://phoenix-gen-api.hexdocs.pm/architecture.md)
- [Configuration](https://phoenix-gen-api.hexdocs.pm/configuration.md)
- [Diagnostics](https://phoenix-gen-api.hexdocs.pm/diagnostics.md)
- [Execute Flow](https://phoenix-gen-api.hexdocs.pm/execute_flow.md)
- [FunConfig Reference](https://phoenix-gen-api.hexdocs.pm/fun_config.md)
- [Getting Started](https://phoenix-gen-api.hexdocs.pm/getting_started.md)
- [Relay Messages](https://phoenix-gen-api.hexdocs.pm/relay_messages.md)
- [Step-by-Step Guide](https://phoenix-gen-api.hexdocs.pm/step_by_step_guide.md)
- [Telemetry](https://phoenix-gen-api.hexdocs.pm/telemetry.md)
- [Readme](https://phoenix-gen-api.hexdocs.pm/readme.md)

## Modules

- [PhoenixGenApi](https://phoenix-gen-api.hexdocs.pm/PhoenixGenApi.md): PhoenixGenApi is a framework for building distributed API systems with Phoenix.
- [PhoenixGenApi.ArgumentHandler](https://phoenix-gen-api.hexdocs.pm/PhoenixGenApi.ArgumentHandler.md): Validates and converts request arguments according to configured type specifications.
- [PhoenixGenApi.ChannelHelpers](https://phoenix-gen-api.hexdocs.pm/PhoenixGenApi.ChannelHelpers.md): Shared push-handling logic for GenApi WebSocket channels.
- [PhoenixGenApi.ConfigDb](https://phoenix-gen-api.hexdocs.pm/PhoenixGenApi.ConfigDb.md): A GenServer-based cache for storing `FunConfig` structs, using an ETS table as the
backing store.
- [PhoenixGenApi.ConfigFailed](https://phoenix-gen-api.hexdocs.pm/PhoenixGenApi.ConfigFailed.md): Tracks FunConfig entries that failed validation during pull or push.
- [PhoenixGenApi.ConfigPuller](https://phoenix-gen-api.hexdocs.pm/PhoenixGenApi.ConfigPuller.md): This module is responsible for periodically pulling function configurations (`%FunConfig{}`)
from remote nodes and updating the `ConfigDb`.
- [PhoenixGenApi.ConfigPusher](https://phoenix-gen-api.hexdocs.pm/PhoenixGenApi.ConfigPusher.md): A client-side module used on remote/service nodes to push configurations
to the PhoenixGenApi gateway/server node.
- [PhoenixGenApi.ConfigReceiver](https://phoenix-gen-api.hexdocs.pm/PhoenixGenApi.ConfigReceiver.md): A server-side GenServer that receives pushed configs from remote nodes.
- [PhoenixGenApi.Diagnostics](https://phoenix-gen-api.hexdocs.pm/PhoenixGenApi.Diagnostics.md): Runtime diagnostics, monitoring, and debugging utilities for PhoenixGenApi.
- [PhoenixGenApi.Executor](https://phoenix-gen-api.hexdocs.pm/PhoenixGenApi.Executor.md): The core execution engine of PhoenixGenApi.
- [PhoenixGenApi.Executor.RetryState](https://phoenix-gen-api.hexdocs.pm/PhoenixGenApi.Executor.RetryState.md): Retry state for executor retry operations.
- [PhoenixGenApi.Helpers.Shared](https://phoenix-gen-api.hexdocs.pm/PhoenixGenApi.Helpers.Shared.md): Shared utility functions used across PhoenixGenApi modules.
- [PhoenixGenApi.Hooks](https://phoenix-gen-api.hexdocs.pm/PhoenixGenApi.Hooks.md): Provides before/after execution hooks for `FunConfig`.
- [PhoenixGenApi.ImplHelper](https://phoenix-gen-api.hexdocs.pm/PhoenixGenApi.ImplHelper.md): Macro to generate simple implementation of protocol.
Support for easy to use with general encoder.
- [PhoenixGenApi.JsonConfig](https://phoenix-gen-api.hexdocs.pm/PhoenixGenApi.JsonConfig.md): Utility module for exporting %FunConfig{} to JSON format.
- [PhoenixGenApi.NodeSelector](https://phoenix-gen-api.hexdocs.pm/PhoenixGenApi.NodeSelector.md): Provides node selection strategies for distributed request execution.
- [PhoenixGenApi.Permission](https://phoenix-gen-api.hexdocs.pm/PhoenixGenApi.Permission.md): Provides permission checking functionality for API requests.
- [PhoenixGenApi.RateLimiter](https://phoenix-gen-api.hexdocs.pm/PhoenixGenApi.RateLimiter.md): Provides rate limiting functionality for API requests.
- [PhoenixGenApi.Relay](https://phoenix-gen-api.hexdocs.pm/PhoenixGenApi.Relay.md): Relay message feature for PhoenixGenApi.
- [PhoenixGenApi.RelayServer](https://phoenix-gen-api.hexdocs.pm/PhoenixGenApi.RelayServer.md): Serializes all relay group ETS operations to prevent race conditions.
- [PhoenixGenApi.Security](https://phoenix-gen-api.hexdocs.pm/PhoenixGenApi.Security.md): Provides security utilities for PhoenixGenApi.
- [PhoenixGenApi.StreamCall](https://phoenix-gen-api.hexdocs.pm/PhoenixGenApi.StreamCall.md): A GenServer that manages a streaming function call.
- [PhoenixGenApi.Structs.FunConfig](https://phoenix-gen-api.hexdocs.pm/PhoenixGenApi.Structs.FunConfig.md): Defines the configuration for a function that can be called through the API.
- [PhoenixGenApi.Structs.PushConfig](https://phoenix-gen-api.hexdocs.pm/PhoenixGenApi.Structs.PushConfig.md): Represents the data a remote node pushes to the PhoenixGenApi server node.
- [PhoenixGenApi.Structs.Request](https://phoenix-gen-api.hexdocs.pm/PhoenixGenApi.Structs.Request.md): Request struct for internal using, convert data map from websocket api.
- [PhoenixGenApi.Structs.Response](https://phoenix-gen-api.hexdocs.pm/PhoenixGenApi.Structs.Response.md): Defines the structure of a response sent back to the client.
- [PhoenixGenApi.Structs.ServiceConfig](https://phoenix-gen-api.hexdocs.pm/PhoenixGenApi.Structs.ServiceConfig.md): Service configuration struct that defines how to connect to a remote service
and pull its function configurations.
- [PhoenixGenApi.Structs.StreamHelper](https://phoenix-gen-api.hexdocs.pm/PhoenixGenApi.Structs.StreamHelper.md): Helper struct and functions for sending streaming data to a `StreamCall` process.
- [PhoenixGenApi.Telemetry](https://phoenix-gen-api.hexdocs.pm/PhoenixGenApi.Telemetry.md): Telemetry integration for PhoenixGenApi.
- [PhoenixGenApi.WorkerPool](https://phoenix-gen-api.hexdocs.pm/PhoenixGenApi.WorkerPool.md): Generic worker pool for executing tasks asynchronously.
- [PhoenixGenApi.WorkerPool.CircuitBreaker](https://phoenix-gen-api.hexdocs.pm/PhoenixGenApi.WorkerPool.CircuitBreaker.md): Shared circuit breaker functions for WorkerPool and Worker.
- [PhoenixGenApi.WorkerPool.Worker](https://phoenix-gen-api.hexdocs.pm/PhoenixGenApi.WorkerPool.Worker.md): Individual worker process for executing tasks.
- [PhoenixGenApi.WorkerPool.WorkerPoolSupervisor](https://phoenix-gen-api.hexdocs.pm/PhoenixGenApi.WorkerPool.WorkerPoolSupervisor.md): Supervisor for worker pools.

- Exceptions
  - [PhoenixGenApi.Errors.DecodeError](https://phoenix-gen-api.hexdocs.pm/PhoenixGenApi.Errors.DecodeError.md): Error raised when request payload decoding fails.
  - [PhoenixGenApi.Errors.InvalidType](https://phoenix-gen-api.hexdocs.pm/PhoenixGenApi.Errors.InvalidType.md): Error raised when an argument has an invalid type.
